categories.label: Early embryo
categories.definition: Human preimplantation embryo RNA or published embryo gene-activation evidence.

categories.label: Oocyte / maternal
categories.definition: Oocyte RNA, oocyte protein, or published maternal-effect function; species is recorded for each finding.

categories.label: Reproductive secretion
categories.definition: Curated publications identifying reproductive-tract secretions or sperm-associated proteins produced in the reproductive tract.

categories.label: Testis / male germ cells
categories.definition: RNA in testis tissue or cells, including male germ cells.

categories.label: Placenta / trophoblast
categories.definition: RNA in placental tissue or cells, including trophoblast populations.

categories.label: Gastrulation
categories.definition: RNA in the human Carnegie-stage-7 embryo dataset.

categories.label: Other reproductive
categories.definition: Released reproductive association without one of the more specific reproductive tags above.

categories.label: Other developmental
categories.definition: Released developmental association without a stage-specific tag in this annotation.

categories.label: Not categorized
categories.definition: No biological category has been assigned in this annotation.

rules.normal_context_input: All supported testis, placenta and oocyte contexts from the pinned normal-expression replay, before the display top-five limit
rules.developmental_support: At least 20 cells, 5 positive cells and 10% positive at 1 TPM; lineage mean at least 5 TPM
rules.assignment: Multiple tags per protein; evidence records retain the study, stage, compartment and measured value. Biological tags do not change CTA admission.

curated_assignments.label: LEUTX
